svg.text: Why does it feel like I’m staying down when I’m not?

text.tspan: The move happens below your eye line, so you don’t see it happen.
In your impact frame[2] your hips are 7% of body height[3]
closer to the ball than at address. In the wall drill, the moment
your trail glute leaves the wall is the moment you stand up.

text.tspan: rotation
Sit with both knees bent to 90°:
one leg in front, one to the side.
Keep your chest tall. Turn slowly
until both knees face the other side.
Pause, turn back. Eight each side,
two rounds.
